newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPANISH FIRST DIVISION STRIKE LOOMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPANISH FIRST DIVISION STRIKE LOOMS.

text.p: The possibility of a New Year strike in the Spanish first division grew on Monday when the players' organization rejected a proposal to reschedule games from December 29 to January 1.

The assembly of the Association of Spanish Footballers decided unanimously against accepting the proposal, which was made by the clubs as a compromise offer after players had complained about losing their traditional Christmas break.

The players, who feel they should have been consulted before the games were scheduled, object to playing on December 22, 29 and January 5, and have put forward two alternative dates later in the year for the matches scheduled for December 29.
Many players have talked about the possibility of striking to ensure their demands, although Association president Gerardo Gonzalez tried to play down this option..
"We've gone through all of the possibilities, but I don't even want to pronounce the word 'strike'," said Gonzalez.
